criteria.resolution: Document an applicable basis for the particular artwork use: license/service terms or an evaluated exception. Assess cover thumbnails separately from the public generated-character collection; replace material where no basis is established.
Original EmuDen contributions are explicitly GPL-3.0-or-later. Build-17 source is public with anonymous checksum verification; verify final build-18 matching release and maintain recipient access.
Document compliance with the applicable GPLv3, store terms, EULA and distribution conditions; seek qualified advice for unresolved issues. GPL-family licensing is not an automatic App Store ban.
84 full notice/license texts and hashed inventory are generated and accessible offline. Verify the final signed bundle and source delivery; other distribution terms are tracked separately.
Pages, authorized public email and in-app links are implemented. Verify final anonymous deployment; App Privacy/host retention remains separate.
Verify host retention and accurate data disclosures, or remove automatic external artwork requests.
Complete applicable encryption/export classification and required documentation.
Resolve applicable guideline 4.7 index, universal-link and age-control requirements for the bundled demo/local imports.
Complete appropriate name/icon/presentation clearance for intended markets.
Verify the final release on supported physical devices, remove unsupported public placeholders, and match metadata/screenshots to it.
